items.title: My honest opinion to how I think the Rising of the Shield Hero should end. [SPOILERS?]
items.text:
My honest opinion to how I think the Rising of the Shield Hero should end. [SPOILERS?]
Give Myne the most gruesome death that deaths can give. I don’t even care about the king at this point. Just give Myne the Chelsea style death from Akame ga Kill and then play the end credits pretty pls. The episode this week just made my hate boil to another level for that pompous laughing potato.

Also throw in a happy ending for Naofumi and Raphtalia.

Thanks for joining my Ted Talk.
